title: Luxuriously Spicy Egyptian Morbier Pasta
description: A spicy and creamy Egyptian dish featuring morbier cheese, perfect for midnight cravings, and can be made dairy-free friendly.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion until translucent.
Add the garlic and red pepper flakes to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the morbier cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet, tossing to combine with the cheese sauce.
Add some reserved pasta water to the skillet to create a creamy emulsion.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with chopped fresh parsley.
If desired, add some extra red pepper flakes for extra heat.
